steps.name: Install the verified wasm-tools release asset
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/sdk-wasm-tools.tar.gz"
bindir="$RUNNER_TEMP/sdk-wasm-tools-bin"
mkdir "$bindir"
timeout 90s gh api -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' repos/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/assets/483720667 | head -c 5862465 > "$archive"
unset GH_TOKEN
test "$(stat --format=%s "$archive")" = 5862464
printf '%s  %s\n' d0efb16c9c859137b7ab3e99151c299cd47caee106ed4594561002f7a04945bd "$archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xOzf "$archive" wasm-tools-1.254.0-x86_64-linux/wasm-tools > "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$(stat --format=%s "$bindir/wasm-tools")" = 20231696
printf '%s  %s\n' cc1f862d69363aac2d4a88f01c414a2dcf10858632d0c0a45e93ff60503979d6 "$bindir/wasm-tools" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$bindir/wasm-tools"
test "$("$bindir/wasm-tools" --version)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0 (bb58fdf91 2026-07-20)'
printf '%s\n' "$bindir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Exercise ordinary synchronization source with bounded test ports
Install pinned validation and bindings
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/guest-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Qualify proposed transaction shapes with the maintained async C compiler
Compile the authored transaction aggregate and forbidden immediate HTTP variant
Build and execute signed C and Rust capability packages
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
python3 tools/build_guest_capsules.py --output "$LSF_GUEST_CAPSULES" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-build.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --test guest_sdk -- --ignored --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-runtime.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-signing --test guest_provenance 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-provenance.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-control-store --lib managed_lease_failure_never_mutates_or_renews_a_historical_replay 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-control-lease.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-policy --lib mutation_renewal_persists_a_full_window_even_before_the_sampler_margin 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-guest-clock-window.log"

steps.name: Qualify standalone C projects and the printed guide
Qualify captured C libraries with enforced compiler isolation
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
LSF_REQUIRE_COMPILER_ISOLATION=1 python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_c_application_dependencies tools.tests.test_c_static_symbols tools.tests.test_captured_compiler_isolation tools.tests.test_application_dependency_tools tools.tests.test_c_dependency_authoring tools.tests.test_c_authoring_frontend
python3 tools/qualify_c_capsules.py --application-dependencies --static-application-dependencies --approved-generator --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/c-application-library"
